obligations.description: Result should remain non-negative under validated inputs

assumptions.description: Account balance must be non-negative before any withdrawal operation
assumptions.justification: Bank account balances are constrained to non-negative integers by account creation and deposit policies; a negative pre-existing balance would indicate a prior system error

assumptions.description: Withdrawal amount must be non-negative; negative withdrawals would constitute unauthorized deposits
assumptions.justification: Withdrawal API schema enforces non-negative transaction amounts at the request validation layer
